text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel came to watch the race 
together with Sakura Chiyono O and Sakura 
Bakushin O. All three hailed from the 
"Victory Club."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
According to them, the Victory Club was 
home to many trailblazers. Among them were 
Umamusume who had made comebacks from 
devastating injuries.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel explains that the low-strain 
training routine devised by the Club had 
been a great help to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, to use as reference for 
injury prevention, the Trainer borrowed 
documents from the Victory Club. They were 
records of the Umamusume's harrowing 
battles with illness and injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, the Trainer had a nightmare. A 
dream where Sakura Laurel suffered an 
injury during an away race— ...A 
terrifying nightmare they never wished to 
see come true.
